limitations: All seven original submissions and 23 physical pages were read completely before opening the frozen counterpart inventory. All 58 claims, supported and unresolved, were independently reviewed.
Primary-source figures in BNetzA slide 11 and Frontier Figure 5 were visually inspected. The relevant operator releases, legal paragraphs, physical-path FAQ and primary study methods were re-read.
No raw inventory, main data, code or README edits. The counterpart raw hash was rechecked.
Some primary documents are current consolidated or retrieved snapshots; stated amendment dates predate authorship, but exact historical page bytes and the dispatched draft identity remain qualified.
No new author-error candidate emerged. Existing unresolved numerical, forecast, legal-shorthand and individual-tariff outcomes are preserved.
Several raw anchors are extremely short or partial words. Exact characters alone can be insufficiently precise; the two partial-word cases are explicitly flagged for correction in integration.
